attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Calder Combine now has five settlements.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"now\" implies a change from an earlier state the briefing does not give"},{"span":"They seem to be expanding their influence","severity":"minor","reason":"implies expansion; framed as a guess, but \"now has\" presents growth as fact"},{"span":"their bountiful harvests","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news (the good harvests) as background in a new item"},{"span":"The Ditch Kings relieved a grain barge on the delta.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"relieved\" is a euphemism for robbed; the fact is softened but not changed"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"The lead item is correct, but the second item pads a quiet week and \"now has\" implies growth the briefing never reports. The dry voice is generic, and \"relieved\" could confuse a player about whether it was a robbery."}
